hostExamples.title: Generic mcpServers JSON
hostExamples.whenToUse: your host supports HTTP MCP directly.
hostExamples.secretNote: Keep the developer token machine-local and send it only in the Authorization header.

hostExamples.title: Codex remote setup
hostExamples.whenToUse: Codex should connect to the hosted UAT MCP endpoint directly.
hostExamples.secretNote: Configure the Authorization bearer header in the host secret store; never put the token in the URL.

hostExamples.title: Codex npm bridge
hostExamples.whenToUse: Codex should launch a local stdio MCP bridge instead of remote HTTP MCP.
hostExamples.secretNote: Keep {{TOKEN_ENV_VAR}} local. The backend endpoint and token should not be committed.

hostExamples.title: npm bridge config
hostExamples.whenToUse: your host expects a local stdio process but supports generic mcpServers JSON.
hostExamples.secretNote: Keep {{TOKEN_ENV_VAR}} local. This should match the same endpoint and token you use for remote MCP.

hostExamples.title: Claude remote custom connector
hostExamples.whenToUse: Claude should use the same hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint used by MuleSoft and other remote hosts.
hostExamples.secretNote: Add the public HTTPS URL through Claude Customize > Connectors, not claude_desktop_config.json. In Advanced settings, enter the provisioned Hussh Technologies OAuth client ID and secret from the approved secret manager. Claude uses authorization code with S256 PKCE, so the exact callback https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback must be registered. OAuth does not replace scoped consent.

hostExamples.title: Cursor / VS Code remote JSON
hostExamples.whenToUse: your editor host understands mcpServers JSON and can call remote MCP directly.
hostExamples.secretNote: Keep the bearer token in the host secret store; query-string authentication is rejected.

hostExamples.title: Raw remote MCP URL
hostExamples.whenToUse: your host only asks for the MCP endpoint URL.
hostExamples.secretNote: Use the exact slash-safe mount shape and configure Authorization: Bearer <developer-token> separately.
